title.value: Cancel streaming subscriptions with ChatGPT Agent

introduction.value: A writer had the agent cancel Peacock, Disney and Netflix after logging in; it needed a nudge and may be blocked on some sites.

method.value: The writer turned on ChatGPT Agent (Plus or Pro) and asked it to cancel Peacock, Disney and Netflix. She typed her credentials into the login screens herself. The agent worked in a controlled browser, reading pages as screenshots and clicking through the cancellation menus one service at a time. She watched it work and approved the final confirmation.

outcome.value: She had no problems cancelling all three. She says results vary by site: some have anti-bot defenses, and Amazon Prime and Google One may block or flag the agent.

notes.value: Stick to low-stakes tasks and don't hand over credentials you wouldn't want exposed. OpenAI warns against using agent mode for financial actions, so confirm the final click yourself.

introduction.en: A writer tested browser-based assistance for ending three streaming memberships.
introduction.zh: 一位作者测试了通过浏览器辅助取消三项流媒体会员。

method.en: The writer activated ChatGPT Agent with a paid plan and requested cancellation of Peacock, Disney and Netflix, entering credentials herself.
method.zh: 作者在付费计划中启用ChatGPT Agent，要求取消Peacock、Disney和Netflix，并亲自输入登录凭据。

method.en: The agent used a controlled browser and screen observations to move through each cancellation process; the writer watched and approved the final confirmation.
method.zh: Agent在受控浏览器中观察页面并逐一完成退订流程，作者在旁监督并批准最终确认。

outcome.en: All three subscriptions were reportedly cancelled successfully; the introduction also notes that the agent could need a nudge.
outcome.zh: 据述三项订阅均成功取消；简介同时提示agent可能需要提醒。

notes.en: The source warns that anti-bot measures can change results and names Amazon Prime and Google One as possible blockers. Its caution about low-stakes tasks and credential exposure is part of the historical account.

Try it yourself
with

Copy prompt
I want to cancel my subscriptions to [service 1, service 2, service 3]. I will log in when you ask. Go through each cancellation flow, decline retention offers, and stop at the final confirm button to show me the end date and any charges before I approve. When done, give me a list of what was cancelled and what you could not cancel.
